_sources._rule: Nothing on the sheet that is not in one of these. Never print the supplier's name or model code. 'src' on each line is for review only, never printed.

name: Selectable Floodlight

description.t: A die-cast floodlight with field-selectable wattage and colour temperature: one fixture covers 40, 60 and 80 W and 3000, 4000 and 5000 K, set on site.
Ships with a slipfitter (-SF) or a yoke (-Y) bracket; the head aims from 0 to 90 degrees.
description.src: lc (SF / Y) + gen9 'Multiple Installation & Bracket Options', 'adjustable angle 0-90'

overview.t: Die-cast ADC12 aluminium housing with integrated heat-dissipation fins
IP65, wet location; drainage groove keeps water off the housing
overview.src: gen9 'Strong Waterproof Performance', 'Environment Location Wet Location'
gen9 'The Yoke, Slip-fitter and Knuckle can be interchangeable for 80W-120W'

specs: gen9 'Black and gray-brown finishes are for choices'
For a pole up to Ø60 mm (2.36 in)
gen9 'The maximum diameter of lamp pole is Ø60'

ordering.src: lc (part numbers and descriptions as LED Connection sells them)

setup.t: Turn the power off. Lay the fixture face down.
setup.src: gen9 NOTE 2 + 'Step 1: Put the front of fixture downward'

setup.t: Unscrew the selector cover on the back with a cross (Phillips) screwdriver and set it aside.
Set the wattage and CCT switches to the setting the design calls for.
Screw the cover back on before the fixture is powered.

notes.t: Electrical work by qualified persons only. Ground the fixture.
Rated 120-277 V: a 480 V circuit needs a step-down transformer ahead of the fixture.
notes.src: follows from the voltage rating; Kroger 345 FL1 ships with one

notes.t: Do not wipe with water or caustic solutions, and avoid high-pressure washing.
